mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, create_time, update_time, creator_id, updater_id, is_deleted, owner_dept_id, owner_id, version, sale_no, sale_name, status, remark
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.sale_no, t.sale_name, t.status, d.dict_label AS status_name, t.create_time, u.nickname AS creator_name, t.remark, t.version FROM sale_quotation t LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_value = t.status::varchar AND d.dict_type = 'audit_status' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.creator_id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.is_deleted = false

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sale_quotation WHERE is_deleted = false
AND status = #{status}

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS biz_date, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count FROM sale_quotation WHERE is_deleted = false AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY biz_date
